verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a dedicated Sandbox environment with signup, credentials, faucets for test crypto assets, and explicit guidance to mock flows, execute transfers, and test integrations covering payments/payouts (mint/redeem orchestrations) and conversions, plus a Dashboard test-webhook feature for deterministic event testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deterministic test-value behavior (e.g., specific test amounts triggering specific outcomes) and independent/hands-on developer confirmation of sandbox fidelity.
